reason: A browser plugin that notifies users when DeepSeek Harness session turns finish, with outcome, visibility, and keyword-filter controls.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话回合完成时发送浏览器系统通知，并支持按结果、可见性和关键词进行筛选。
summaries.en: Sends browser system notifications when DeepSeek Harness session turns finish, with filters for outcome, visibility, and keywords.

capabilities: Shows browser system notifications for completed session turns
Reads a bounded session completion projection containing turn reason, reply text, and tool names
Applies client-side include and exclude keyword rules
Stores notification preferences in browser localStorage
